title: Law to streamline city reporting rules to Council
summary: This bill would repeal or revise about two dozen city charter and administrative code requirements that agencies submit periodic reports to the City Council, eliminating outdated or duplicative reports and adjusting due dates for others. Affected topics include taxi commission reports, bridge and tunnel conditions, domestic violence data, homeless deaths, child fatalities, hepatitis prevention and diabetes reduction plans, among others. It also repeals the mayor's strategic policy statement requirement and a city healthcare services committee, and ends a marijuana enforcement report.
